newsitem.title: UK: BFI up seven as freight market sentiment improves.
newsitem.headline: BFI up seven as freight market sentiment improves.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) rose seven points to 1,010 on Wednesday which reflected improved demand and rates in the Pacific area which brokers believed will filter through to the US Gulf in the Panamax trades.
Some fresh grain business was agin quoted in the Atlantic where the principal feature has been the continuing strength of the Lakes market.
BIFFEX at 1200 GMT was five points down to unchanged at turnover was 132 lots.
